title: LA Colossal – Kintsugi 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her late 40s, black shoulder-length hair tucked behind the ears, natural face with a composed smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Kintsugi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Satin charcoal-grey stoneware glaze with a subtle sheen and a dense network of many fine raised gold repair seams. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully covered.

Pose: Seated in a minimalist wooden armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch charcoal-glazed platform stiletto d'Orsay pumps with gold heels.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, charcoal with gold seam.

Background & Lighting: Minimal concrete gallery with a single spotlit mended vase, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm spotlight with raking side light making the gold seams glow. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
